summary: Keep recognized unready high-consequence intents terminal and model-free at the Capability-First runtime ingress.
reason: Without a runtime terminal classification, a provider payment intent whose adapter is still candidate could be released to a model even though the canonical Capability Graph marked it tool-required.

tests.name: model-efficiency-unit
tests.evidence: 14 tests passed; unready confirmation-required transaction intent returns known_error, model_bypassed=true and no executor call.

tests.name: cross-repo-classification
tests.evidence: Candidate UI contracts classify Maxit and Topnet eligible, STEG/SONEDE required_capability_not_ready with explicit no-effect text, and creative conversation as miss.

capabilities.reason: Canonical capability mapping and provider route truth are owned by ui-playbooks; this runtime commit consumes that contract.

architecture.reason: Extends the existing Capability-First helper; no new router, store, service, scheduler or execution owner.

rollback: Revert this scoped runtime commit and reactivate the previous release. Validated Maxit/Topnet routes are independently unchanged.
limitations: STEG/SONEDE payment remain unavailable until their own adapters and live contracts are validated.
No financial effect is executed by this runtime classification.
